title: BIOLOG API problem response
description: ADR-0004 Decision 2. The one HTTP error envelope for the whole platform: a direct serialisation of the (message, code, status, detail) shape TenantContextError, ConcurrencyError and AuditError already independently share. Served as application/problem+json. Examples are SYNTHETIC.

code.description: Machine-readable reason. snake_case, matching the reason_code convention used across ADR-0001/0002/0003.

message.description: Human-readable explanation. Never parsed by a machine; code is what a caller branches on.

status.description: The HTTP status of this response, repeated in the body because some transports strip it.

correlation_id.description: ADR-0004 Decision 3: the same evt_ identifier threaded into any audit/domain event this request produced. Never a second, HTTP-only id space.

detail.description: Optional. Built through contracts/js/audit.mjs redact(), never a raw internal object (ADR-0004 Decision 2.3).

errors.description: Present only for a validation failure (ADR-0004 Decision 5.3). Never present alongside a non-validation code.
